title: Spec sheet
intro: The specs you need at the workbench, without digging through manuals.

entries.valueOrImage: Enter a value or attach an image after saving.

autofill.hint: Searches the web for this vehicle (Tavily) and lets Google Gemini pick out values that a search result states, with its link. Check the sources before you save; nothing is saved until you click Save.
autofill.unavailable: Not set up on this server: an administrator needs to set GEMINI_API_KEY and TAVILY_API_KEY.
autofill.summary: {{filled}} values found and filled in, {{kept}} kept because they were already filled in, {{missing}} without a reliable source.
autofill.nothing: No new values: nothing with a reliable source was found ({{kept}} found values were not applied because the fields were already filled in).
autofill.openSource: Open source in a new tab: {{url}}
autofill.sourceLabel: Filled automatically, source: {{name}} (opens in a new tab)
